entries.note: Kinders 2008 (PMID 18980982, Clin Cancer Res 2008-11-01) quote verbatim in abstract. Untested opener holds; veliparib is a member, oral matches the Kummar patients, unselected fits the mixed xenograft panel.

Kummar 2009 (PMID 19364967, epub 2009-04-13) quote verbatim. Retro holds: Kinders public 2008-11, after Fong ASCO 2008 abstract 5510 (2008-05-20) PD-guided olaparib escalation. Oral veliparib; mixed solid tumours/lymphoma = other_disease; proximal readout.

Jones 2009 (PMID 19873981, J Med Chem 2009) quote verbatim in abstract. Untested opener correct; oral niraparib, BRCA1-deficient model = biomarker_selected. Tolerability claim moved to safety, so the harm is counted once.

Quote verbatim in bundle 208447 MultidisciplineR (clin-pharm). PBMC >50% target stated preclinically and reached above 80 mg/day in phase 1 mixed solid tumours: same; other_disease and oral fit; margin_stated false correct.
Jones 2009 abstract quote verbatim; oral niraparib, BRCA-deficient cells/xenograft = biomarker_selected. Untested 2009 opener correct.

NOVA (PMID 27717299, epub 2016-10-07) quote verbatim in abstract; NCT01847274 primary = gBRCA PFS, results posted 2019-05-01. Retro holds: Jones 2009 post-dates Fong ASCO 2008/NEJM 2009 olaparib BRCA ovarian responses. outcome_tested negative per adjudication; oral.

Quote verbatim in bundle 209115 review; next sentence: ALT/AST rises in patients not seen in animals (partial). ARIEL2 (epub 2016-11-29) reported grade>=3 anaemia 22% and ALT/AST rises before the Dec 2016 review: retro holds; oral rucaparib.

Quote verbatim in bundle 208447 review (dog BP/HR rise at 0.7x unbound Cmax, vagotomy caveat). Study first public in 2017 review after NOVA (epub 2016-10-07) and Sandhu 2013: retro holds; oral, stage_or_line fine.
Berek 2018 (PMID 29767688) conclusion verbatim. In-silico model fitted to NOVA platinum-sensitive recurrent patients: stage_or_line, oral niraparib correct; prospective opener untested.
NORA (PMID 33453391, epub 2021-01-14) conclusion verbatim. Platinum-sensitive recurrent, BRCA-mutant and wild-type, so stage_or_line is right; oral niraparib; same with margin_stated true holds.
Drew 2011 JNCI (PMID 21183737, epub 2010-12-23) quote verbatim. Untested 2010 opener; oral rucaparib, BRCA-mutant/silenced models = biomarker_selected.

Swisher 2017 (PMID 27908594, epub 2016-11-29) quote verbatim; NCT01891344 primary PFS by HRD subgroup, results posted 2021-07-13. Single-arm scored on primary in predicted direction; 2016 earliest; retro since Drew post-dates olaparib BRCA responses; oral.

Jones 2009 'well tolerated in vivo' verbatim in abstract; scored as a safety prediction per the drafter brief. Untested 2009 opener at model_first_use_year; oral niraparib; precedes niraparib's first patient data (2010).

NOVA abstract quote verbatim (grade 3-4 thrombocytopenia 33.8%, anaemia 25.3%, neutropenia 19.6%). Mice can show myelosuppression, so silence contradicted: contra. Not retro (Jones 2009 precedes niraparib patients). Ovarian patients measured; stage_or_line, oral.

missing: ARIEL4 (rucaparib vs chemotherapy, BRCA-mutant relapsed ovarian; NCT02855944, results posted 2022-02-11): primary invPFS met (Kristeleit, Lancet Oncol 2022), but final OS 19.4 vs 25.4 months (Lancet Oncol 2025, PIIS1470-2045(24)00674-0); FDA treatment indication voluntarily withdrawn June 2022. Status stays same on the primary endpoint, but efficacy should carry this as a patient_trials item / outcome_tested: negative.
NOVA final OS (gBRCA HR ~0.85, not significant; non-gBRCA OS detriment) led to the 2022 restriction of niraparib 2L maintenance to gBRCA; relevant to outcome_tested, not to the PFS-based status.

Stenoparib (2X-121, member) phase 2 NCT03878849 in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, DRP-selected not BRCA-selected; sponsor press releases only (Allarity 2025), positive in tone, outside the BRCA/HRD population; no failure to add.

Rucaparib efficacy track: ARIEL3 (Coleman 2017 Lancet, doi 10.1016/S0140-6736(17)32440-6, PMID 28916367) BRCA-mutant cohort primary PFS vs placebo is the first randomized patient test of Drew 2011's prediction (ARIEL2 Part 1, Swisher 2017 Lancet Oncol, single-arm, earlier); the track's 'same' should date 2017.
rule_questions: Safety: when an FDA review says animal findings were 'consistent with' the dose-limiting harms but explicitly notes a common patient harm the species could have shown (rucaparib ALT/AST, 74% incidence) was absent, is that same + partial or contra (silence contradicted)?

Efficacy: does outcome_tested apply when the trial primary endpoint (PFS) is met but later OS shows detriment (ARIEL4) — i.e. is PFS a 'surrogate the model predicted' in oncology, and should an OS detriment ever move an efficacy cell?
model_change: is it meaningful on an entry that follows a same (not contra) entry with a different model, or should lint reject model_change: true unless the previous entry is contra?
